description: Demo data for the shipped `Case behandeling` flow. The flow moves a case by the ROLE each status plays, resolved within the case type at run time, because a statusType uuid is minted per installation and a shipped flow cannot carry one. The names below are the readable fallback, not the contract: they were the contract once, and that is exactly why 8 of 18 demo runs died — a subsidy is under `Beoordeling` and a complaint under `Onderzoek`, both correctly, and `name` is `x-translatable` on top of that. The `role` is the contract. This case type is the one that models all six, which is what makes it the flow's happy path; a case type modelling no `pending-info`, `review` or `stranded` skips those steps, and one modelling no `intake`, `in-progress` or `closed` fails the run visibly rather than half-walking it.
